demos.headline: Vague short answers
demos.proves: Follow-ups turn thin answers into checkable evidence.

demos.headline: Denies difficulties, offers an alternative explanation
demos.proves: Denials are recorded as denied — never flipped into absence of evidence.

demos.headline: Gives conflicting accounts across turns
demos.proves: Contradictions stay visible, with both accounts retained.

demos.headline: Incomplete recall with partial detail
demos.proves: “I cannot remember” is respected and logged as a gap, not a finding.

demos.headline: Frequent difficulties across settings, positive screen
demos.proves: A clearly positive screen routes to further assessment — organisation, never diagnosis.

demos.headline: Long-standing difficulties despite heavy coping
demos.proves: Childhood history plus work impact, with coping effort recorded alongside gaps.

watermark: SYNTHETIC DEMO — not a real person
